question: These numbered clips are shuffled segments from one cooking video. Determine their chronological order. Return only clip numbers joined by ->.

observed_information.statement: A wooden spoon rests in a clear bowl with measuring cups and a metal bowl in the background.
Chopped white onions are added to the bowl and gathered by hand.
A block of brown sugar is placed on the chopped onions and then sprinkled over it.
The brown sugar and onions are mixed with a wooden spoon, breaking up the sugar block.
A dark liquid is poured into the bowl with the sugar and onion mixture.
A glass bowl contains a dark marinade with visible chopped ingredients.
Raw meat slices are added to the marinade in the bowl.
Hands mix meat and marinade in the bowl, coating the meat thoroughly.
More meat is added and mixed into the marinade, followed by hand washing under running water.
A lettuce leaf is placed over cooked ribs on a white plate.
A lettuce leaf is wrapped around a rib, forming a wrap.
Ribs are on a grill, and later hands place lettuce leaves over cooked ribs on a paper-lined surface.
